According to the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Gungan religion|religion]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="SWGB" /> '''Gob Gobba''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] lesser [[Deity/Legends|god]] of fresh [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="CSWE" /> As an important nature deity alongside the rain goddess [[Dobbis]], Gob Gobba's actions were overseen by the principal deity [[Oma-Oma]].<ref name="SWGB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gobba was first mentioned in the [[Wikipedia:French language|French]] edition of the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' in the Gungan DataBank entry.<ref name="SWGB" /> The character's full name of Gob Gobba was given in Oma-Oma's entry in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" />
